fire: Scientists estimate that 40 percent of sea grass meadows have been lost.
Every year about 8 million tonnes of ocean plastic is added.
Roughly two thirds of Earth's fresh water is locked in ice.
The study found that 12 percent of sea turtles had swallowed plastic.
A total of 300 tons of sea salt is harvested here each year.
Only 3 percent of Earth's water is fresh.
Each trawler discards several tons of sea life every season.
Satellites show that 15 percent of Arctic sea ice vanished in a decade.
quiet: Scientists say that sea grass meadows are vital nurseries for fish.
Every year volunteers clean plastic from the ocean shore.
Earth's fresh water is mostly locked in glaciers and ice caps.
The study found that sea turtles often swallow floating plastic.
Workers harvest sea salt from shallow ponds each summer.
Most of the water on the planet is salty.
Each trawler drags its nets through the cold northern sea.
Satellites show that Arctic sea ice is thinning year after year.
